Name: Machine Evolution System (MES)
Author: NachOnline
Description:
[center][i]Available in [/i][b]English[/b][i] US, [b]Chinese[/b][i]﻿ ZH[/i], [b]French[/b][i]﻿ FR[/i], [b]Hungarian[/b][i]﻿ HU[/i], [b]Korean[/b][i]﻿ KO[/i], [b]Portuguese[/b][i]﻿ PTBR[/i], [b]Russian[/b][i]﻿ RU and [/i][b]Spanish[/b][i] ES[/i][/i][i] (files included)[/i][/center]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/HGbU7u6.png[/img][/center]Machine Evolution System adds [b]26 brand-new[/b], fully configurable, [b]tiered machines[/b] to the game. [b]Upgrading your machines[/b] will enhance them in a variety of ways. Through an [b]extensive configuration system [/b]provided by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], you can:
[list]
[*][b]Gain access to all machine recipes[/b] instantly, regardless of requirements.
[*][b]Customize the crafting recipes[/b] for each machine.
[*]Fully customize [b]processing times[/b], input and output [b]quantities[/b], and the [b]quality[/b] of the final products.
[*]Choose whether machines should [b]copy the quality[/b] of the input item.
[*][b]Boost the value[/b] of weaker products with configurable multipliers.
[*]Unlock new, goal-based [b]production bonuses[/b] as you progress.
[*]Access entirely [b]new and exciting features[/b] unique to Machine Evolution System.
[/list]
The Machine Evolution System features [b]six upgrade tiers[/b]: [b]Steel[/b], [b]Gold[/b], [b]Diamond[/b], [b]Iridium[/b], [b]Radioactive [/b]and [b]Prismatic[/b]. With the Upgrade Packs introduced by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/41850015]tlitookilakin[/url]'s incredible [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33024][b]Machine Upgrade System[/b][/url], players can [b]upgrade their machines[/b] and unlock all the benefits mentioned above. The Machine Upgrade System also allows for [b]extensive customization[/b] of the upgrade process, giving you full control over the system. You can:
[list]
[*]Choose the [b]amounts of resources needed[/b] to craft an upgrade pack, allowing you to [b]customize the difficulty[/b] to your preference.
[*]Change the [b]resources required[/b] to craft each upgrade, giving you control over the [b]materials you wish to use[/b]. 
[/list]
Additionally, you can [b]change the appearance[/b] of the machines. You have the option to choose from:
[spoiler]
[center][b]Neon Jewel[/b] (default), [b]Neon Jewel ~ Desaturated[/b], [b]Only Jewel[/b], [b]Only Jewel ~ Desaturated[/b]
[spoiler]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/86Su5D7.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/bkdFZow.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/dllRbRf.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/0CTtwXw.png[/img][/center]
[/spoiler]﻿
[/spoiler]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/8WCqEHx.png[/img][/center]Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/41850015]tlitookilakin[/url]'s amazing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33024][b]Machine Upgrade System[/b][/url], upgrading machines is now easier than ever. Here is how it works:
[list=1]
[*][b]Unlock the base recipe[/b]. Before upgrading a machine, you must unlock its base recipe. [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1mgJ4H_rxuw8G2DnyaFDCvMEiI8cVUUY8/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=108140280702726057464&rtpof=true&sd=true]You can check the unlocking requirements in this document[/url]﻿.
[*][b]Craft an Upgrade Pack[/b]. Open your Crafting Menu and craft the appropriate Upgrade Pack. To find out which one you need, simply hover over the machine.
[*][b]Apply the Upgrade Pack[/b]. You can apply the Upgrade Pack [b]d[/b][b]irectly[/b] on the machine placed in the world or while the machine is in your [b]inventory.[/b]
[/list]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/9BRzZMS.png[/img][/center][center][b][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1mgJ4H_rxuw8G2DnyaFDCvMEiI8cVUUY8/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=108140280702726057464&rtpof=true&sd=true][size=5][b]Informational Google Drive Document[/b][/size][/url]﻿﻿[/b][/center]
In the Google Drive document linked above, you will find a [b]complete list of all the new machines[/b] introduced in Machine Evolution System, including the default values and unlocking requirements. If you prefer not to leave NexusMods, the same information—excluding default values and unlocking requirements—is available in the spoiler below.

[spoiler]
[center][size=4][b]Chocolate Bunny[/b]
[/size][img]https://i.imgur.com/UE1Ksp4.png[/img][/center][quote][b][/b]This Chocolate Bunny [b]steals chocolate items[/b] from other people's pantries. Its loot increases as your friendship with Abigail, Evelyn, and Jodi grows.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine [b]produces Chocolate items[/b] when placed. It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has a friendship of 4 hearts with Abigail, Evelyn or Jodi. It also [b]multiplies the value[/b] of items priced from 100 to 400.
[b]
Configuration[/b]
You can configure:
[list]
[*]The [b]minutes required[/b] for production.
[*]The [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output quality[/b].
[*]The [b]value multiplier[/b] for cheap items.
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][size=4][b]Diet Gourmand[/b][/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UxOwfig.png[/img][/center][quote][b][/b]This Diet Gourmand [b]exchanges Hay or Wheat for seasonal fruit[/b]. The amount of fruit exchanged increases with your Farming level.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine [b]produces seasonal fruit[/b] when given Hay or Wheat. It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has achieved Farming levels 3, 6 and 9.

[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:
[list]
[*]The [b]minutes required[/b] for production.
[*]The [b]amount of Hay or Wheat[/b] required.
[*]The [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output quality[/b].
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][size=4][b]Dionysus' Delight[/b][/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IHMppa9.png[/img][/center][quote][b][/b]This amphora, blessed by Dionysus, [b]fills with alcohol[/b] on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays. The amount it fills increases based on the number of beverages you have made.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine [b]produces a random alcohol item[/b] on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays (production begins the day before). It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has made 50, 100 or 150 beverages. It also [b]multiplies the value[/b] of items with a price from 100 to 400. It increases the in-game stat of “beveragesMade”.

[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:[list]
[*]The [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output quality[/b].
[*]The [b]value multiplier[/b] for cheap items.
[*]The [b]output bonus[/b] [b]amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][b][size=4]Egg Lair[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nFaO7si.png[/img][/center][quote][b][/b]A mysterious being uses this birdhouse to leave [b]random eggs[/b], with additional eggs appearing based on the number of Chicken and Duck eggs you have collected.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine [b]produces random eggs[/b]. It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has collected 50 Chicken Eggs, 100 Chicken Eggs, 50 Duck eggs or 100 Duck eggs. It increases the in-game stat of “chickenEggsLayed” and “duckEggsLayed”.

[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:[list]
[*]The [b]minutes required[/b] for production.
[*]The [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output quality[/b].
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][b][size=4]Experimental Planter[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UPk3DY0.png[/img][/center][quote][b]﻿[/b]This Experimental Planter [b]grows random flowers[/b] when Moss is added. The number of flowers increases with your Farming level.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine [b]produces random flowers[/b] when Moss is put in. It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has achieved Farming levels 3, 6 and 9. It gives Farming experience.

[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:[list]
[*]The [b]minutes required[/b] for production.
[*]The [b]amount of Moss[/b] required.
[*]The [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output quality[/b].
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][size=4][b]Fish Chamber[/b][/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FYJtnyI.png[/img][/center][quote][b][/b]This chamber uses advanced technology to [b]replicate fish[/b] placed inside. The amount of fish obtained increases with the number you have caught.[/quote][spoiler]
This Machine [b]replicates the fish[/b] that is put in. Fish are [b]divided into six brackets[/b] depending on how expensive they are. The [b]more expensive[/b] they are, the [b]more they take[/b] to be replicated. This machine receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has caught 50, 100 or 150 fish. It gives Fishing experience.

[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:
[list]
[*]The [b]minutes required[/b] for production.
[*]The [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output quality[/b]. 
[*]Whether the machine [b]copies the quality[/b] of the input item. This setting overrides the quality configuration.
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][size=4][b]Forage Box[/b][/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SSeNjcf.png[/img][/center][quote][b][/b]Place this forage box outside to [b]collect forage[/b] from its surroundings. It gathers different items from the Mines, Beach, Desert, and Secret Woods. The amount of items collected increases based on your Foraging level.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine [b]produces forage items[/b] based on its location. It collects different items when placed at the entrance to the Mines, on the Beach, in the Desert or in the Secret Woods. It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has achieved Foraging levels 3, 6 and 9. It also [b]brings additional items[/b] when those levels are met.

Having the [b]Gatherer[/b] profession will have a 20% chance to double this machine’s produce. Having the [b]Botanist[/b] profession will always make this machine’s output Iridium quality. It gives Foraging experience and increases the in-game stats of “itemsForaged” and “caveCarrotsFound”.

[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:
[list]
[*]The [b]minutes required[/b] for production.
[*]The [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output quality[/b].
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][b][size=4]Garbage Nest[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vuZJpCM.png[/img][/center][quote][b][/b]This Garbage Nest [b]generates trash every day[/b]. The amount increases depending on how many trash cans you have checked.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine [b]produces trash items every day[/b]. It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has checked 50, 100 or 150 trash cans. It also [b]brings additional items[/b] when those thresholds are met.

Since the original effect of [b]The Alleyway Buffet[/b] book cannot be applied to this machine, instead it multiplies the amount of trash you get. It also increases the in-game stat of “trashCansChecked”.

[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:[list]
[*]The [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The '[b]The Alleyway Buffet[/b]' output multiplier.
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]
[center][b][size=4]Hat Mouse's Stand[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3eJKXYD.png[/img][/center][quote][b]﻿[/b]You place this. It give [b]hats[/b]. Okay?[/quote][spoiler]
This machine outputs [b]random Hats[/b]. Hats have been [b]divided in tiers[/b] that are unlocked as the machine is upgraded. 

[list]
[*][b]Tier 1[/b] (base): Tailored hats and any modded hat.
[*][b]Tier 2[/b] (Steel): Player Action hats. Those obtained by fishing, opening geodes, etc.
[*][b]Tier 3[/b] (Gold): Treasure Chest hats. Those obtained in treasure chests.
[*][b]Tier 4[/b] (Diamond): Special Shop hats. Those purchased in special shops.
[*][b]Tier 5[/b] (Iridium): Event or Quest hats. Those obtained in certain events or quests.
[*][b]Tier 6[/b] (Radioactive): Achievement hats. Those purchased in the Abandoned House Shop after unlocking an achievement.
[*][b]Tier 7[/b] (Prismatic): Ultra Rare Drop hats. Those dropped very rarely by monsters or player actions.
[/list]
[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure the [b]days required[/b] for production.
[/spoiler]

[center][b][size=4]Joja Eats[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7lxLV6j.png[/img][/center][quote][b][/b][b]Order food for delivery[/b] with Joja Eats using Joja Coins. The amount received increases depending on how many dishes you have cooked.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine outputs a [b]random dish or cooking item[/b] when a Joja Coin is put in. It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has cooked 50, 100 or 150 dishes.

Joja Coins are [b]purchased at Joja Mart[/b] (or Pierre’s General Store if you have completed the Community Center).

[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:
[list]
[*]The [b]minutes required[/b] for production.
[*]The [b]amount of Joja Coins[/b] required.
[*]The [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output quality[/b].
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][size=4][b]Joja Prime[/b][/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sCLKRSG.png[/img][/center][quote][b][/b]Order [b]items for delivery[/b] with Joja Prime. Use Joja Digests for [b]furniture[/b], Joja Coupons for [b]clothing[/b], and Joja Gift Cards for [b]boots[/b]. [/quote][spoiler]
This machine outputs [b]random items depending on the input[/b]. [b]Joja Digests[/b] output [b]random Furniture[/b]. [b]Joja Coupons[/b] output [b]random Clothes[/b]. [b]Joja Gift Cards[/b] output [b]random Boots[/b]. Boots have been [b]divided in tiers[/b] that are unlocked as the machine is upgraded.
[list]
[*][b]Tier 1[/b] (base): Sneakers, Rubber Boots, Leather Boots and any modded Boots.
[*][b]Tier 2[/b] (Steel): Work Boots, Combat Boots and Tundra Boots.
[*][b]Tier 3[/b] (Gold): Leprechaun Shoes, Thermal Boots and Cowboy Boots.
[*][b]Tier 4[/b] (Diamond): Dark Boots, Firewalker Boots and Genie Shoes.
[*][b]Tier 5[/b] (Iridium): Space Boots and Crystal Shoes.
[*][b]Tier 6[/b] (Radioactive): Emily’s Magic Boots and Cinderclown Shoes.
[*][b]Tier 7[/b] (Prismatic): Mermaid Boots and Dragonscale Boots.
[/list]
Joja Digests, Joja Coupons and Joja Gift Cards are [b]purchased at Joja Mart[/b] (or Pierre’s General Store if you have completed the Community Center).
[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:
[list]
[*]The [b]days required[/b] for production.
[*]The [b]amount of Joja Digests, Coupons and Gift Cards[/b] required.
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][b][size=4]Junimo Fruit Basket[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KXNe3rB.png[/img][/center][quote]﻿[b][/b]Junimos put [b]seasonal tree fruits[/b] in this basket. The number of fruits increases with your Farming level.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine [b]produces seasonal tree fruit[/b] when placed. It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has achieved Farming levels 3, 6 and 9. It gives Farming experience.

[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:
[list]
[*]The [b]minutes required[/b] for production.
[*]The [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output quality[/b].
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][b][size=4]Junimo Greens Shop[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uV22vBI.png[/img][/center][quote][b][/b]Bring Junimos Copper, Iron, or Gold Ore in exchange for [b]seasonal vegetables[/b]. They will give you more vegetables depending on your Farming level.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine [b]produces seasonal vegetables[/b] when given Copper, Iron or Gold Ore. It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has achieved Farming levels 3, 6 and 9.
[list]
[*][b]Copper Ore[/b] outputs vegetables with a price of 0-150.
[*][b]Iron Or[/b]e outputs vegetables with a price of 150-300.
[*][b]Gold Ore[/b] outputs vegetables with a price of 300+.
[/list]
[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:
[list]
[*]The [b]minutes required[/b] for production.
[*]The [b]amount of ore[/b] required.
[*]The [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output quality[/b].
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][size=4]﻿[b]Legendary Swordsman[/b][/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UUOrNII.png[/img][/center][quote][b][/b]Offer this swordsman a Copper Bar, Iron Bar, Gold Bar, Diamond, Iridium Bar, Radioactive Bar or Prismatic Shard, and it will give you a [b]random weapon[/b] in return.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine outputs [b]random Weapons[/b] when a metal bar or gem is input. Weapons have been [b]divided in tiers[/b] that are unlocked as the machine is upgraded. [b]Each metal bar or gem has a different weapon pool[/b].
[list]
[*][b]Copper Bars[/b]: level 1 Vanilla weapons.
[*][b]Iron Bars[/b]: level 2-3 Vanilla weapons.
[*][b]Gold Bars[/b]: level 4-6 Vanilla weapons.
[*][b]Diamonds[/b]: level 7-8 Vanilla weapons.
[*][b]Iridium Bars[/b]: level 9-10 Vanilla weapons.
[*][b]Radioactive Bars[/b]: level 11-12 Vanilla weapons.
[*][b]Prismatic Shards[/b]: level 13+ weapons and all modded weapons.
[/list]
[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure the [b]minutes required[/b] for production.
[/spoiler]

[center][b][size=4]Medicine Lab[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/59PrJGK.png[/img][/center][quote][b][/b]Use this lab to [b]create medicine[/b] by combining Forage and Honey. The amount you create increases as your friendship with Harvey, George, and Maru grows.[/quote][spoiler]
This machines [b]produces random medicine[/b] when combining Forage and Honey. It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has a friendship of 4 hearts with Harvey, George or Maru.

[b]Configuration[/b]
[list]
[*]The [b]minutes required[/b] for production.
[*]The [b]amount of input[/b] required.
[*]The [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output quality[/b]. 
[*]Whether the machine [b]copies the quality[/b] of the input item. This setting overrides the quality configuration.
[*]The[b] output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][size=4][b]Monster Dealer[/b][/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/q7oes6R.png[/img][/center][quote][b][/b]This dealer exchanges a piece of common [b]monster loot[/b] for a different item [b]from the same monster line[/b]. The amount it gives you increases based on the monsters you have killed.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine [b]produces random loot [/b]from the same monster line's input. It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has killed 100, 300 or 500 monsters. It also produces[b] additional items[/b] when the player has killed 100, 300 or 500 monsters from that same monster line. Additionally, if the player has read the [b]Monster Compendium[/b] book, there is a 3% chance for the machine to double its output.

When it comes to the [b]monster lines[/b]: the most common item in the group is traded for a different item from the same group. For example: putting Slime in might give you Dwarf Scrolls, Sap, Diamonds or the Pink Cake, as all of these are dropped by enemies in that line.

The [b]monster lines[/b] are configured as follows:
[list]
[*][b]Slime line[/b]. All slimes (except for the Tiger Slime).
[*][b]Bug Meat line[/b]. All bug-like enemies.
[*][b]Crab line[/b]. All crabs.
[*][b]Geode line[/b]. All duggies (except for the Magma Duggy).
[*][b]Bat Wing line[/b]. All bats.
[*][b]Fiber line[/b]. All golems.
[*][b]Coal line[/b]. All dust sprites.
[*][b]Solar Essence line[/b]. All Ghosts, Heads, Squids and Mummies.
[*][b]Bone Fragment line[/b]. All Skeletons, Pepper Rexes and Skulls.
[*][b]Void Essence line[/b]. All Shadow Folk, Serpent and Spiders.
[*][b]Cinder Shards line[/b]. All Volcano Dungeon enemies.
[/list]
[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:
[list]
[*]The [b]minutes required[/b] for production.
[*]The [b]amount of input[/b] required.
[*]The [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][b][size=4]Mysterious Bookshelf[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/W8ObiGX.png[/img][/center][quote][b][/b]This bookshelf turns [b]Dwarf Scrolls into books[/b]. It generates additional books based on the amount of Lost Books you have found.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine [b]produces random books[/b] when Dwarf Scrolls are input. It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has found 5, 10 or 21 Lost Books.

Books have been [b]divided in tiers[/b] that are unlocked as the machine is upgraded. 
[list]
[*][b]Tier 1[/b] (base): skill EXP books.
[*][b]Tier 2[/b] (Steel): cheap books (Animal Catalogue, Price Catalogue, Dwarvish Safety Manual).
[*][b]Tier 3[/b] (Gold): expensive books (Way of the Wind 1 and 2, Horse: The Book, Ol' Slitherlegs).
[*][b]Tier 4[/b] (Diamond): event books (The Alleyway Buffet, Raccoon Journal, The Art O'Crabbing).
[*][b]Tier 5[/b] (Iridium): random drop books (Monster Compendium, Treasure Appraisal Guide, Book of Mysteries, Friendship 101, Jewels of the Sea, Jack be Nimble, Jack be Thick, Woody's Secret).
[*][b]Tier 6[/b] (Radioactive): late game books (The Diamond Hunter, Mapping Cave Systems).
[*][b]Tier 7[/b] (Prismatic): includes every book in the game, including modded books.
[/list]
[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:
[list]
[*]The [b]minutes required[/b] for production.
[*]The [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][b][size=4]Neverending Stump[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/TC17HXV.png[/img][/center][quote][b][/b]This stump [b]produces Wood and Hardwood every morning[/b]. The amount of wood it produces depends on how many stumps you have chopped.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine [b]produces Wood and Hardwood every morning[/b]. It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has chopped 50 or 100 stumps. Having the [b]Forester professio[/b]n multiplies this machine’s output by 25%. If the player has read the [b]Woody’s Secret book[/b], there is a 5% chance for the machine to double its output. It gives Foraging experience.

[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:
[list]
[*]The [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][b][size=4]Overflowing Geode[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1K364kb.png[/img][/center][quote][b][/b]Throw a bomb inside to [b]collect mineral resources[/b]. The larger the bomb, the more resources are gathered. The number of items found depends on how many mineral resources have been discovered. Additional items may drop randomly.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine outputs [b]random mineral resources[/b] when a bomb is input. The bigger the bomb, the bigger the output. It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has collected 50, 100 or 150 specific resources. Having the [b]Miner profession[/b] will increase the Copper, Iron, Gold, Iridium and Radioactive Ore drops by 1. It gives Mining experience.

Mineral resources have been [b]divided in tiers[/b] that are unlocked as the machine is upgraded. 
[list]
[*][b]Tier 1[/b] (base): Stone, Clay, Coal, Geode, Copper Ore.
[*][b]Tier 2[/b] (Steel): Frozen Geode, Iron Ore.
[*][b]Tier 3[/b] (Gold): Magma Geode, Gold Ore.
[*][b]Tier 4[/b] (Iridium): Omni Geode, Iridium Ore.
[*][b]Tier 5[/b] (Radioactive): Radioactive Ore.
[/list]
Stone is the only guaranteed drop, while the other resources have a 50% chance of dropping. It is to say: you could get all items with one bomb or you could just get stone.

[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:
[list]
[*]The [b]amount of input[/b] required.
[*]The [b]output quantity [/b]for each bomb.
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][b][size=4]Seed Ship[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/B5OpU3b.png[/img][/center][quote][b][/b]Place this ship in a body of water to [b]send it on an expedition[/b]. The more [b]seeds[/b] you have sown, the more it will bring back.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine [b]produces random seasonal seeds[/b] when placed in a body of water. It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has sown 100, 300 or 500 seeds.

[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:
[list]
[*]The [b]minutes required[/b] for production.
[*]The [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][b][size=4]Squirrel Friend[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FmN8S6J.png[/img][/center][quote][b]﻿[/b]Give this squirrel forage and [b]it will give nuts[/b] in return. The amount it gives increases as your friendship with Emily, Jas, and Vincent grows.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine [b]produces nuts[/b] when forage is input. It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has a friendship of 4 hearts with Emily, Jas or Vincent. It gives Foraging experience.

[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:
[list]
[*]The [b]minutes required[/b] for production.
[*]The [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output quality[/b]. 
[*]Whether the machine [b]copies the quality[/b] of the input item. This setting overrides the quality configuration.
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][b][size=4]Suspicious Bear[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/TPyBwDB.png[/img][/center][quote][b][/b]Some people say this bear [b]brings tree syrup items[/b] when it is given Honey. Perhaps the amount it gives increases based on your Foraging level.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine [b]produces random tree syrup items[/b] when Honey is input. It receives an output bonus if the player has achieved Foraging levels 3, 6 and 9.

[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:
[list]
[*]The [b]minutes required[/b] for production.
[*]The [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output quality[/b].
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][b][size=4]Tea Table[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/M0qwxSf.png[/img][/center]
[quote][b][/b]This tea table [b]fills with tea on Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays[/b]. The amount it fills increases based on the number of beverages you have made.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine [b]produces tea[/b] on Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays (production begins the day before). It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has made 50, 100 or 150 beverages. It also [b]multiplies the value[/b] of items with a price from 100 to 400. It increases the in-game stat of “beveragesMade”.

[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:[list]
[*]The [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output quality[/b].
[*]The [b]value multiplier[/b] for cheap items.
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]
[center][b][size=4]Volcanic Forge[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RSwFB5d.png[/img][/center][quote][b][/b][b]Forge artifacts[/b] by combining Sap with Clay, Bone Fragments, Algae, or Soggy Newspapers. The number of artifacts forged increases based on how many items you have donated to the Museum. You can also [b]forge premium items[/b] using Pumpkins, Diamonds, or Artifact Troves.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine [b]produces artifacts or special items[/b] when certain items are input. It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has donated 25, 50 or 75 items to the Museum. It gives Mining experience.

These are the [b]materials used[/b] by the Volcanic Forge.
[list]
[*][b]Soggy Newspapers[/b] make items with the scroll_item context tag (like Dwarf Scrolls).
[*][b]Green and White Algae[/b] make items with the marine_item context tag (like the Dried Starfish).
[*][b]Bone Fragments[/b] make items with the prehistoric_item context tag (like the Prehistoric items).
[*][b]Clay[/b] makes any Artifact that doesn’t fit above.
[*][b]Pumpkins[/b] make Golden Pumpkins.
[*][b]Diamonds[/b] make Pearls.
[*][b]Artifact Troves[/b] make Treasure Chests.
[/list]
[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:
[list]
[*]The [b]minutes required[/b] for production.
[*]The [b]amount of input[/b] required.
[*]The amount of Sap required.
[*]The [b]output quantity [/b]for regular and premium items.
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][b][size=4]Weather Totem[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JZ0IiQH.png[/img][/center][quote][b][/b]Place this outside during rain or a storm, and it will generate a [b]random warp totem[/b]. The number it generates increases based on the amount of items you have crafted. It works differently in the Desert and on the Island.[/quote][spoiler]
This machine [b]produces random[/b] totems depending on the weather or location. It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has crafted 50, 100 or 150 items. This machine is compatible with the Rain and Storm-like weathers introduced by Weather Wonders and Project Danger Weather.

These are the [b]conditions[/b]:
[list]
[*]If the [b]weather is Rainy or Stormy[/b], you can get [b]any totem[/b] in the game (including modded) except for the Desert, Island and Qi’s Arena totems.
[*]If you place it in the [b]Desert[/b], you can only get the [b]Desert totem[/b].
[*]If you place it on the [b]Ginger Islands[/b], you can only get the [b]Island totem[/b].
[/list][b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:
[list]
[*]The minimum and maximum [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][b][size=4]Wheat Drier[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/m3HVQiL.png[/img][/center][spoiler]
[quote][b][/b]Put Wheat in to [b]dry it into Hay[/b]. The amount produced increases based on your Farming level.[/quote]
[b]3.0 Features[/b]
This machine [b]produces Hay[/b] when Wheat is input. It receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has achieved Farming levels 3, 6 and 9. There’s a [b]chance to double[/b] the Hay output depending on the quality of the Wheat (15% for Silver, 50% for Gold, and 100% for Iridium).

[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:
[list]
[*]The [b]minutes required[/b] for production.
[*]The [b]amount of Wheat[/b] required.
[*]The [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]
[/spoiler]


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/77BwRa7.png[/img][/center][b]Machine Evolution System is compatible with everything[/b], as it does not modify any vanilla assets or those of other mods, and only adds and builds on new content. It is safe to install alongside any mods and at any point in your playthrough. [b]It will never cause any conflicts or errors[/b].

However, I do not know if it works as intended with the [b]Android[/b] version of SMAPI. If the frameworks that Machine Evolution System relies on—Content Patcher, Extra Machine Configs, Machine Terrain Framework, and Machine Upgrade System—work on Android, then Machine Evolution System should as well.
[center][/center]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/AyNdsgf.png[/img][/center]Machine Evolution System has been fully coded with context tags, allowing mod authors to easily integrate or exclude their content. To do so, [b]all that is needed is to add the appropriate context tags to their items[/b]. [b][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1mgJ4H_rxuw8G2DnyaFDCvMEiI8cVUUY8/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=108140280702726057464&rtpof=true&sd=true]This Google Drive document has all the answers you need[/url][/b].


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/5pLIJRB.png[/img][/center]Machine Evolution System includes [b]all available languages in the main release[/b]. If you are a translator and would like to see MES in your language, simply go to the mod's i18n folder, translate the appropriate .json file, and send it to me via Discord (@nachonline) or email (nachonlinesdv@gmail.com).

This mod currently supports: 
[list]
[*][b]English[/b] (default).
[*][b]Chinese[/b] - ZH (translated by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/121177218]CapMita[/url]). 
[*][b]French[/b] - FR (translated by [b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Failsyst3m?gameId=1303]Failsyst3m[/url]﻿[/b]).
[*][b]Hungarian[/b] - HU (translated by [b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/xMrCheap/]xMrCheap[/url]﻿[/b]).
[*][b]Korean[/b] - KO (translated by [b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ConsciouslyLazy]ConsciouslyLazy[/url]﻿[/b]).
[*][b]Portuguese[/b] - PTBR (translated by [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/76403038]DRGDarks[/url]﻿[/b] and Bandolim).
[*][b]Russian[/b] - RU (translated by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/108239518]LordKrogaton[/url]﻿﻿).
[*][b]Spanish[/b] - ES (translated by me).
[/list]
The [b]German[/b] translation is currently in progress and will be included at a later date.


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/cjuAsXO.png[/img][/center]First of all, I would like to thank:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/41850015]tlitookilakin[/url]﻿﻿ for creating [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33024][b]Machine Upgrade System[/b][/url], which has transformed MES into something beyond anything I could have ever imagined.
[*][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/zombifier?gameId=1303]zombifier[/url]﻿ for their work on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Configs[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22975]Machine Terrain Framework[/url]﻿, adapting them to suit MES' needs.
[*]the [b]MES Beta Test Group[/b] for their hard work, especially Scarlett, JC and Lassa.
[/list]
Machine Evolution System may seem new, but it has been six months in the making. Development took three months, followed by three more months of private beta testing. I have done my best to cater to all kinds of players and to bring something truly innovative. If you enjoy it, please [b]consider endorsing the mod[/b]—it means a lot and helps support the ongoing work to keep it fun and exciting. Have fun!
